fields.name: Service type value
fields.description: Service type value bits: 0000=signalling, 0001=data, 0010=mobile terminated services, 0011=emergency services, 0100=emergency services fallback, 0101=high priority access, 0110=elevated signalling, 0111=unused (signalling), 1000-1011=unused (signalling/data)

notes: The service type information element is coded as shown in figure 9.11.3.50.1 and table 9.11.3.50.1
